replies.text: {"verdicts":[{"id":"T1","keep":true,"reason":"Design has web-triggerable deep link pre-filling payee/amount; concrete attacker-funded-transfer attack."},{"id":"T2","keep":true,"reason":"Attacker-controlled payee/amount reaching backend is distinct server-side trust/validation attack."},{"id":"T3","keep":true,"reason":"Custom scheme registration is in design; scheme hijacking by malicious app is a concrete distinct attack."},{"id":"T4","keep":true,"reason":"Design states pre-filled confirmation screen with no step-up; local/malicious-app abuse differs from remote web attack."},{"id":"T5","keep":true,"reason":"Design confirms any website can trigger link; repeated invocation DoS is concrete."},{"id":"T6","keep":true,"reason":"Design lacks provenance recording for externally triggered payments; dispute/fraud-detection harm is concrete."}]}
